title: A record left out of the reveal
story: The client's metadata reveal leaves out one record, the 30-word plan A1's agent showed at 19:33:05. The server stored the batch's root with that record in it.
edits: The transcript's user entry for each prompt, read by the log reader 0.7 to 4.5 s after the hook (via log, same turn_key and lengths), as a real Claude Code client records it.
The reveal has no record 9033, the agent.output at 19:33:05. events.jsonl keeps it, as the client recorded it.

CC6.basis: Stated, not recomputed: the server's re-score lacks the plan, which only fills A1's reading bucket, and that bucket is drained in 19:33, which CC7 holds. Nothing drains it past its 20 s base anyway, because B1's lead starts at 19:33:20, so every other minute reproduces.

CC10.reason: no editor act in the submission

notes: The batch from 19:33:00.7 to 19:33:58 doesn't reproduce: one record short, so its root and head differ from the server's, and seq skips. Every other batch reproduces against the server's stored prev. Its records are unverified, so CC7 holds every minute from the last verified record before it, A1's prompt at 19:33:00, to the first after it, A1's stop at 19:34:00: 19:33 and 19:34, 120 s.

Without batch 3009's revealed records the re-score changes only in 19:33, which the span holds. A1's prompt is the hook record 9030 in batch 3008, so the log copy 9032 changes nothing; 3009's samples and tool call bear on 19:33 alone; and its outputs ask no question and can't drain after B1's lead begins at 19:33:20 or after B1's prompt resets the bucket. So CC7 holds no other minute.
